body.zh-Hant: 何塞·桑托斯·塞拉亞生於1853年，德國國家圖書館權威檔記他的出生地是馬拿瓜，1919年5月17日在紐約去世。權威檔的職業欄寫他是總統與政治人物，並以「1893至1910年尼加拉瓜總統」概括其任職。
body.en: José Santos Zelaya was born in 1853; the German National Library authority record gives Managua as his birthplace and says he died in New York on 17 May 1919. The record lists him as a president and politician and summarises his office as president of Nicaragua from 1893 to 1910.

citations.quote: José Santos Zelaya ( b. 31 October 1853; d. 17 May 1919)
"label" : "Managua"

1893-1910 Präsident von Nicaragua

heading.en: Coming to power in 1893 and the new constitution

body.zh-Hant: 史坦西弗的條目說，塞拉亞於1893年9月藉革命上台，任期記為1893至1909年。1893年憲法加強市政、禁止修道院與女修道院、保障世俗教育，並設一院制議會、廢除死刑。他也推動出口農業，並特別重視鐵路建設與在馬拿瓜湖、尼加拉瓜湖行駛的汽船。條目又說他操控選舉、以獨裁方式統治，並面對約十五次保守派的嚴重推翻企圖。
body.en: Stansifer's entry says Zelaya came to the presidency in September 1893 by revolution and dates his presidency 1893–1909. The Constitution of 1893 strengthened municipal government, prohibited convents and monasteries, guaranteed lay education, established a unicameral legislature and abolished the death penalty. He promoted export agriculture and gave particular attention to railways and to steamships for lakes Managua and Nicaragua. The entry also says he managed elections, ruled as a dictator and faced about fifteen serious Conservative attempts to overthrow him.

heading.zh-Hant: 中美洲聯合與米斯基托海岸
heading.en: Central American union and the Miskito Coast

body.zh-Hant: 對外方面，條目說塞拉亞1895年支持成立由尼加拉瓜、薩爾瓦多與宏都拉斯組成的大共和國（República Mayor）。他上任第一年派兵到米斯基托人的總部布魯菲爾茲，並驅逐英國領事；英國於1904年簽署條約，承認尼加拉瓜完全主權。條目又說，美國因他不接受對運河區的治外法權要求而與他談判停擺。
body.en: On foreign affairs the entry says that in 1895 Zelaya supported the creation of the República Mayor, a union of Nicaragua, El Salvador and Honduras. In his first year in office he sent troops to Bluefields, headquarters of the Miskitos, and expelled the British consul; Great Britain signed a treaty in 1904 accepting full Nicaraguan sovereignty. The entry adds that negotiations with the United States stalled over his resistance to Washington's demand for extraterritorial jurisdiction over the canal zone.

citations.quote: he lent his support in 1895 to the creation of the República Mayor
In his first year in office Zelaya determined to recapture

expelled the British consul

body.zh-Hant: 條目寫道，1909年兩名美國傭兵被處決的事件，使華盛頓決定支持反對塞拉亞的叛亂。塞拉亞認識到無法在美國反對下留任，於1909年12月辭職並流亡。
body.en: The entry states that an incident in 1909 involving the execution of two U.S. mercenaries led Washington to support a rebellion against Zelaya. Recognising that he could not stay in office against U.S. opposition, Zelaya resigned and went into exile in December 1909.

people.name: Pṛthvī Vīra Vikrama Śāha (Prithvi Bir Bikram Shah)
people.nameZh: 普里特維·比爾·比克拉姆·沙阿

body.zh-Hant: 海德堡科學人文院的《尼泊爾文獻》人名資料記載，普里特維·比爾·比克拉姆·沙阿生於1875年8月18日，父親是王儲特拉伊洛基亞·比爾·比克拉姆·沙阿；他是尼泊爾國王，在位期間為1881年5月17日至1911年12月11日，並於1911年12月11日去世。
body.en: The Heidelberg Academy's Documenta Nepalica name record says Pṛthvī Vīra Vikrama Śāha was born on 18 August 1875 and was the son of Crown Prince Trailokya Vīra Vikrama Śāha; it describes him as King of Nepal, reigning from 17 May 1881 to 11 December 1911, and gives 11 December 1911 as the date of his death.

citations.quote: born: 18 August 1875;
father: Crown Prince Trailokya Vīra Vikrama Śāha
King of Nepal (r. 17 May 1881 – 11 December 1911)
died: 11 December 1911;

body.zh-Hant: 法國學者西爾萬·列維（Sylvain Lévi）在《尼泊爾：一個印度教王國的歷史研究》中寫道，1881年國王蘇倫德拉·比克拉姆·沙阿（Surendra Vikrama Sāh）去世，此前他在位三十四年，統治只具名義。他的孫子普里特維·比拉·比克拉姆·沙阿（Pṛthivī Vīra Vikrama Sāh）生於1875年，隨後登上王位，列維寫作時仍在位。
body.en: In Le Népal, the French scholar Sylvain Lévi writes that King Surendra Vikrama Sāh died in 1881 after a thirty-four-year reign that was purely nominal. His grandson Pṛthivī Vīra Vikrama Sāh, born in 1875, then took the throne, which he still held when Lévi wrote.

citations.quote: En 1881 le roi Surendra Vikrama Sâh
mourut après trente-quatre ans de règne purement
nominal. Son petit-fils Prthivî Vîra Vikrama Sâh, né
en 1875, monta sur le trône qu'il occupe encore

body.zh-Hant: 列維記載，1885年11月22日又一場家族慘劇，使榮格·巴哈杜爾（Jang Bahādur）的侄子們掌握了權力。在榮格死後接任首相的拉諾迪帕·辛哈（Ranoddīpa Simha）遭到刺殺，維拉·沙姆謝爾（Vīra Çama Sher，即 Bir Shamsher）出任首相。
body.en: Lévi records that on 22 November 1885 another family tragedy brought Jang Bahādur's nephews to power. Ranoddīpa Simha, who had become prime minister on Jang's death, was assassinated and Vīra Çama Sher (Bir Shamsher) became prime minister.

citations.quote: Le 22 novembre 1885, un nouveau drame de famille
amenait au pouvoir les neveux de Jang Babâdur, les fils
A sa mort Ranoddîpa Simha, son frère, devint premier ministre
Ranoddtpa Simha fut assas- siné
Vira Çama Sher (Bir Sham Sher) Jang Rana Balladur devint premier ministre.

heading.en: Lévi's account of his position at court

body.zh-Hant: 列維在同書第一卷寫到，當時的國王普里特維·比拉·比克拉姆·沙阿（Prthvi Vira Vikrama Sāha）的稱號是阿迪拉賈（Adhirāja，俗稱 Dhirāj），被限制在宮中生活。列維的評語是，他沉溺於女色與酒，在盛大典禮的日子被當成毫無自主意識的人偶展示。
body.en: In the first volume Lévi says the reigning king, Prthvi Vira Vikrama Sāha, bore the title Adhirāja (popularly Dhirāj) and lived confined in his palace. Lévi's own verdict is that he was given over to women and drink and was displayed like an unaware doll on days of great ceremony.

citations.quote: Le roi, Prthvi Vira Vikrama
Sâha porte le titre d'Adhirâja (vulg. Dhirâj) ; il vit confiné
dans son palais, livré aux femmes et à la boisson, exhibé
comme une poupée inconsciente aux jours de grande céré- monie.

gaps.note: 名單 5442 的職稱欄為「: Śāha」疑似殘缺，非本檔所能判斷；Documenta Nepalica 稱 King of Nepal。
